# coolify_storage (Resource)

Persistent storage attached to an application, service or database (docs: knowledge-base/persistent-storage). `type = "persistent"` mounts a named Docker volume (or a host directory via `host_path`); `type = "file"` mounts a file whose content is managed inline.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Named volume.
resource "coolify_storage" "uploads" {
  parent_type = "application"
  parent_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
  type        = "persistent"
  name        = "uploads"
  mount_path  = "/app/uploads"
}

# Inline config file mount.
resource "coolify_storage" "config" {
  parent_type = "application"
  parent_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
  type        = "file"
  mount_path  = "/app/config.yml"
  content     = file("${path.module}/config.yml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mount_path` (String) Path inside the container.
- `parent_type` (String) `application`, `service` or `database`. Changing it forces replacement.
- `parent_uuid` (String) UUID of the parent resource. Changing it forces replacement.
- `type` (String) `persistent` (volume) or `file` (file mount). Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `content` (String) File content (`file` only).
- `host_path` (String) Host directory to bind-mount instead of a named volume (`persistent` only).
- `name` (String) Volume name (required for `persistent`, invalid for `file`).

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
